script_text: Stop, Cancer—your ruler the Moon is exposing a truth you’ve been avoiding. Your ruling planet, the Moon, glides through Taurus in your 11th House, forming a sextile to your natal Cancer Sun, making friendships and future plans feel surprisingly clear. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Leo in your 2nd House of money trines Saturn in Aries in your 10th House of career, rewarding patience with tangible recognition. As a water sign, your instincts read undercurrents others miss. In love, don’t hide behind old moods; a sincere message can reopen a door, and taken Cancer should watch for jealousy dressed as concern. At work, follow the numbers, not the noise—an invoice, bonus, or overdue payment moves forward, and a colleague’s idea can become your income stream. Avoid emotional spending and signing without reading twice. The blessing is a quiet ally who sees your potential. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
